entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return an order. Order number is VF78-9912. Just tell me yes or no.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. VF78-9912. So I can pull up the right information, what specifically is the issue with the item?
Look, it's simple. It's a helmet. The color is not what I expected. The box is unopened. I just need a return label. Can you send one?
Understood. One moment while I pull up your order details... Okay, I see you received the item just 8 days ago. That's well within our 90-day return policy, so a return is no problem at all.
Great. So you're sending the label?

Yes, absolutely. We want you to be completely satisfied. Choosing the right helmet is critical for your safety, and we understand that being happy with the color is part of that. I have just approved the return in our system.
You'll receive an email with the return instructions and a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just print that out, attach it to the original package, and drop it off with the carrier.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can...
